title: [PDF] Anticancer potential of curcumin: preclinical and clinical studies. | Semantic Scholar
abstract:
An update of the bioavailability and pharmacokinetics of curcumin is provided and the recently identified molecular pathways responsible of its anticancer potential in CRC are described.Expand
An update of the bioavailability and pharmacokinetics of curcumin is provided and the recently identified molecular pathways responsible of its anticancer potential in CRC are described.Expand
It is suggested that curcumin is a potent antiproliferative agent for breast tumor cells and may have potential as an anticancer agent.Expand
Various in vitro and in vivo pharmacological aspects of curcumin as well as the underlying action mechanisms are summarized, which suggest anticancer, antiviral, antiarthritic, anti-amyloid, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties.Expand
Few analogues of curcumin have shown very potent results and may be considered as clinical candidates for the development of future anticancer agent.Expand
